MORAVEL letters are small direct tonal ink, narrow spaced DIN Condensed-like uppercase, no patch, no bright white logo. No other text, brand or decorative seam signature. New photograph generated from text only. EXACT 4:5 canvas 1122x1402 pixels, full garment centered with generous margins. Not square, not collage.
